designs.note: 40111 one whole humpback breaching (not diving), so --view 'Breaching' replaces 'Diving'; 40110 headless body like an aeroplane, in a frame with a fake caption; 40112 diving but no eye or jaw, stubby fins, grey haze, frame, fake caption. Cream paper flattened to white, faint sea lines under the tail painted out. fails [], 23.3 x 31.8 cm.

truth.note: Counted: two pectoral fins (the long knobbly near one, the far one behind it), one dorsal fin on the back (drawn larger and more serrated than a real humpback's), one fluke, one eye, throat grooves, tubercles on the jaw. One animal. Humpback whale, breaching.

designs.note: All three NAUTILUS mains rejected (40120 two spirals fused, 40121 blobby lobes and fake handwriting, 40122 trumpet-like spout). Backup AMMONITE: 40126 one clean spiral with outward ribs; 40125 a broken second curl, 40127 a smeared oval disc with a stray outline. Paper painted white. Options adapted from the nautilus's: --sub 'Fossil cephalopod' --view 'Side view' --views 1. fails [], 25.0 x 31.8 cm.

truth.note: One planispiral shell, one centre, the whorls tightening evenly, ribs curving outward, the last whorl ending in its aperture. An ammonite, not a nautilus (ribbed, no smooth shell or section), so titled AMMONITE.

generator_note: generate_sdxl.py unchanged; no out-of-memory. About 4 minutes an image (233-259 s), UNet at 10.8 GB RSS. Main run 06:46-07:13, backup 07:13-07:26, one process at a time.
